chars.TEACHER: a Moroccan male primary-school teacher about 45 years old, thick black mustache, short greying hair, rectangular brown glasses, brown tweed blazer over a beige shirt, holding a wooden ruler
chars.BOY: a shy Moroccan boy about 9 years old, short curly black hair, wearing a light blue school smock over a red sweater

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan public primary school classroom. Seen from the student desks: TEACHER stands at the front, mid-gesture, pointing his wooden ruler straight at BOY who is half-standing up from his wooden desk in the foreground, nervous. Head-to-waist framing, TEACHER's face clearly visible with a stern smirk. Green chalkboard behind him with no writing. 2D cartoon storybook style.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Monday morning, TEACHER walks briskly into a Moroccan primary classroom through the wooden door, briefcase in one hand, raising the other hand to announce something to the class, energetic expression. Rows of children at old wooden desks seen from behind. 2D cartoon storybook style, no text anywhere.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: TEACHER stands at the front of the classroom holding up one finger as if saying 'one minute each', looking at the class; BOY sits at a desk in the foreground, swallowing nervously, hands gripping the desk edge. 2D cartoon storybook style, no text anywhere.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: TEACHER points his ruler at BOY, calling him to come to the front; BOY slowly stands up from his desk, frozen with fear, wide eyes, other kids turning their heads to look at him. 2D cartoon storybook style, no text anywhere.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: BOY stands alone in front of the blank green chalkboard facing the class, trying hard to speak, mouth tense, cheeks red, sweat drop on his forehead, hands clenched at his sides, stuttering. Seen from the students' desks. 2D cartoon storybook style, no text anywhere.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A whole classroom of Moroccan children at wooden desks laughing loudly and pointing; in the background BOY stands embarrassed at the front by the chalkboard, shoulders hunched. Comic but awkward mood. 2D cartoon storybook style, no text anywhere.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: TEACHER at the front of the classroom bursts out laughing too, one hand on his belly, the other hand pointing at BOY as if mocking him like a comedian; BOY stands next to him by the chalkboard, crushed and lowering his head. 2D cartoon storybook style, no text anywhere.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: BOY, head down, starts walking back toward his desk; TEACHER firmly stretches out his ruler in front of him to stop him, strict face, ordering him to stay standing at the front. Classroom with children watching. 2D cartoon storybook style, no text anywhere.
